notes: Pinned to upstream tag v18.1.14 as observed on 2026-09-08; the previous gateway pin was v17.4.1 / 9350b7990d26ebf69a604edc82d8558ef04adf30. Published releases retain their original pins and qualification.

The standalone mbox uses the maintained v18.1.14 gateway-collaboration series and carries the gateway-specific encrypted health probes and response acknowledgements. See patches/oh-my-pi/README.md for exact patch provenance and verification.
No supported extension collaboration controller exists at this commit; the slash command directly owns CollabHost.
The collab-web connect path writes the capability to location.hash, so the gateway integration requires a reviewed in-memory bootstrap patch.

The vendored client preserves the gateway in-memory bootstrap and local browser patches recorded in packages/collab-client/upstream/UPSTREAM.json. It keeps npm marked so the bundled runtime closure stays pure JavaScript instead of pulling @oh-my-pi/pi-natives and its per-platform binaries.
